report_name: Nutex Health Discloses Data Breach; 'The Gentlemen' Ransomware Claims Attack

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation that first appeared in mid-2025 and gained prominence in 2026. The group's affiliates are opportunistic, targeting a wide variety of sectors, and claimed responsibility for the attack on Nutex Health via their dark web leak site.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through double-extortion ransomware attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The Gentlemen affiliates often gain initial access by scanning for and exploiting unpatched vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications like firewalls and VPN gateways.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The Gentlemen affiliates are known to exploit vulnerabilities in external remote services like VPNs to gain an initial foothold in target networks.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: As part of their double-extortion tactic, The Gentlemen affiliates exfiltrate large volumes of sensitive data to their own servers before deploying ransomware.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Gentlemen ransomware payload is deployed to encrypt files across the victim's network, rendering them inaccessible to force a ransom payment.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware attempts to delete volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin to prevent easy recovery of encrypted files.

malware.name: The Gentlemen Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by 'The Gentlemen' RaaS operation. It is deployed after data exfiltration to encrypt victim systems as part of a double-extortion scheme.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by the ransomware to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

identities.name: Nutex Health
identities.description: A U.S.-based healthcare provider operating over 27 facilities that suffered a data breach claimed by 'The Gentlemen' ransomware group. Sensitive patient, employee, and business data was exfiltrated.

infrastructure.name: The Gentlemen Dark Web Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web portal used by The Gentlemen ransomware gang to list victims and threaten the publication of stolen data.

infrastructure.name: The Gentlemen Exfiltration Servers
infrastructure.description: Servers controlled by The Gentlemen affiliates used to store large volumes of sensitive data stolen from victims like Nutex Health before encryption.

indicators.name: Ransomware Volume Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Volume Shadow Copy Deletion Attempt
id: 2b8a1c3d-e4f5-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/nutex-patient-data-stolen/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-02
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 'vssadmin delete shadows', a command commonly used by ransomware like The Gentlemen to prevent system recovery.

indicators.name: Ransom Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransom Note File Creation Detected
id: f9e8d7c6-b5a4-4987-8fed-cba987654321
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with names commonly used for ransom notes, such as those ending in '.readme'.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/nutex-patient-data-stolen/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-02
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.readme'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with names like '*.readme', which are characteristic of ransom notes left by ransomware attacks.

relationships.target_name: The Gentlemen Dark Web Leak Site
